text: My office received a resident-led petition to relocate the existing on-street parking on the south side of Eastwood Road between Bellhaven Road and Woodbine Avenue to the north side of the street in order to increase the availability of on-street parking.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing permit parking, regulation in effect, from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m., on the odd (south) side of Eastwood Road, between Normandy Boulevard and Woodbine Avenue. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west and north sides of Eastwood Road from Woodbine Avenue and a point 62 metres south of the north roadway of the east-west leg of Eastwood Road. 3. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Eastwood Road, between Normandy Boulevard and a point 30 metres west of Woodbine Avenue. 4. Prohibited parking except by permit from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily, on the even (north) side of Eastwood Road, between Eastwood Road (north /south branch) and Woodbine Avenue.
